parsed.note_claim: Kai Cenat has not permanently quit streaming; he is on a Twitch hiatus, continues creating content on a secret YouTube channel, and is launching his clothing brand Vivet.

parsed.quote: While his future as a streamer is unclear, Cenat is indeed continuing as a content creator. In fact, he's been uploading various bits of content in secret on a hidden YouTube channel, all while establishing his own fashion brand.
